reports.summary:
G-panels work list closed. The root cause of most remaining slider differences was the slider geometry. Three changes, all taken from figma_file.json:
- The thumb now travels 2 pt inside both track ends, so it sits at 2 at the minimum and at W−10 at the maximum.
- Ticks spread over the 2…W−2 span of the `degrees` frame, and a stepped slider centres its thumb on its tick.
- The fill runs to the thumb's far edge. A centred slider's fill spans the thumb at its value and the thumb at the zero point.

I put this in one small, testable PanelSliderGeometry in PanelControls.swift. End ticks are gone. Ticks are now screen-blended like Figma's `degrees` frames (all 75 use SCREEN), so they read #4B3217 on the fill as in Figma. The selected narrow tab underline is now 70 pt. The Playback tab draws Figma's full-width #222 hairline at y 51. S19 compressor-open and stereoWidener-open now fail only on documented D054 deviations: REVIEW 0.022 % and PASS. One line added to D054 for the Audio tab's '-10 s' typo. Spatializer-open is now PASS (0.003 %). Essential-open structural 0.167 → 0.037 %. S20.Sidebar/subtitles structural 0.094 → 0.034 % with flat colour 0. S18 and S19 sidebars have flat colour 0. Tests: FilterCardParityTests 13/13, PanelAuditRegression 9, PanelsTests 5, SidePanelContent 3 and PanelValuesRegression 4, all passing. In an isolated copy with the HEAD sources, the new and updated tests fail with 9 assertions, so they catch the regression. FigmaDeviationTests validates my new deviations; its only failure is in S71.Onboarding, which another area owns.
fixed: (d)/(a) S18 essential-open, S18 colors-open (Sepia), S19 spatializer-open, S19 stereoWidener-open and S20 Background Opacity: the end ticks are gone. Stepped sliders draw only inner ticks (tickFractions for stops = 1..<stops-1). Ticks now use Figma's 2…W−2 spread and its SCREEN blend. Essential structural 0.167 → 0.037 %, spatializer 0.319 → 0.003 % (PASS). Evidence: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/G-panels/after/S18_Filters_essential-open/side-by-side.png, after/S19_Filters_spatializer-open/, after/S20_appearance-sliders.png; before: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/G-panels/before/S18_Filters_essential-open/side-by-side.png

(d) Stepped thumbs sit on their tick, as in Figma 804:1299 (Font Size Auto at 212), 804:1315 (Outline at 235), 607:1136 (Size 8.0 at 234) and 673:1702. The S18 Banding thumb was 1.5 pt off and is now within REVIEW. Ticks match: in the render, Figma's Feedback slider has 10 marks (8 inner), the same count the product draws. The parity judge's 'Figma 6' was a miscount, so no decision is needed.

(d) Centred delay slider (S20 763:1986, Subtitle Track Delay at −4 s): the fill now ends at 204.0 pt, exactly where Figma does (before: 200). The thumb is at 126.5–134.5 against Figma's 127–135 (before: 125.5–133.5). The 0.5 pt left is Figma placing the −4 s value by hand; the uniform thumb model is checked against Figma's minimum, maximum and centre. S20.Sidebar/subtitles structural 0.094 → 0.034 %, flat colour 0.023 → 0 %. Evidence: after/S20_Sidebar_subtitles/side-by-side.png and before/S20_Sidebar_subtitles/

(a)(d) S18/S19 selected tab underline: it is now 70 pt, at 122–192 for Video and 208–278 for Audio (498:2969/536:1094); before it was 61 pt. The probe matches Figma pixel for pixel (244–383 and 416–555 px at y 97). Evidence: after/S18_Sidebar_video/, after/S19_Sidebar_audio/

(a)(d) S17 Playback tab: added the full-width hairline at y 51 (5187:24342/24374, stroke #222222). Only the Playback frame has it. Render and ref both have #22 or #21 at x 0–799, y 102 px. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/G-panels/after/S17_top-vs-figma.png

(a)(b)(c) S19 compressor-open and stereoWidener-open no longer FAIL without explanation. figmaDeviations citing D054 now cover only the thumbs whose Figma position disagrees with the label (Compressor rows 536:1545/1604/1622/1654/1670/1686, Widener Delay 612:1236) and the 'FM5' / '%' labels. Results: compressor REVIEW (structural 0.022 %, flat 0); stereoWidener PASS (structural 0.001 %). Evidence: after/S19_Filters_compressor-open/report and side-by-side.png, after/S19_Filters_stereoWidener-open/
(d) The '+10 s' label against Figma 536:1087's '-10 s' typo is now recorded in a new D054 bullet.

(c) Verifier open issue 2: the old test pinned our own model; it now asserts Figma's geometry (fill to 184 pt and the thumb at 106.4 ± 1 pt). The new testSliderGeometryMatchesFigmaThumbsFillsAndTicks asserts the Figma node values directly.

S18 colors-open: the threshold sliders' fixture value is now 50 of 0–255. That is the value Figma 614:1483's thumb at 64 pt represents under the product geometry, and Figma shows no number for it. Structural 0.131 → 0.100 %; what is left is the FG/A3 #6B6B6B against #707070 colour of the disabled thumb, Δ5.

issues.description: The Preamp thumb for 12.0 dB is drawn at its value in VLC's −20…20 range, about 80 % along the track, while Figma draws it about 10 pt further right (about 82–84 %). This follows the same D054 rule as the other filter cards ('thumbs sit at their values in VLC's ranges'), but D054 only names Compressor and Stereo Widener. The parity judge asked for the Equalizer example to be added, and the entry has no figmaDeviation, so the check reports REVIEW with an unexplained flat-colour area at 270,104. It needs a one-line D054 example plus a matching figmaDeviation.

The D054 deviations leave out whole slider rows (536:1545, 536:1604, …; 328×24 pt each), which is 25 % of the compressor canvas. That hides the track, fill and tick geometry of those rows as well as the thumb. The raw comparison (--ignore-deviations) confirms the only real differences are thumb position and fill length, which follow from the values, so the deviations are justified. But those rows' slider geometry is now only checked indirectly, through the same component in other entries.

With screen blending in Light, the light BG/Accent Dark tick (#C6AB89) over the light track (#DEDEDE) comes out as about #F8F4F0. The tick is now lighter than the track, where it used to be darker. Figma has no Light frame for this and Dark matches Figma (#4B3217 on the fill). Whether the inverted tick reads well in Light needs a look in the real window.

The Banding Removal Radius thumb is about 2 pt off: Figma's value 14 of 0–32 cannot land on tick 3 of the 8-stop track. Neither is covered by a decision; both are accepted as sub-pixel or fixture-level.

verdict.summary:
I re-checked every item on the G-panels work list myself. Every claimed fix holds, and a code review, build, tests and renders found no blocker or major issue.

**Build and tests**
- `swift build` is clean, with no warnings in Panels files.
- All targeted suites pass: FilterCardParityTests 13, PanelAuditRegression 9, PanelsTests 5, SidePanelContent 3, PanelValuesRegression 4 and FigmaDeviationTests 6/6.
- **The new tests catch the old behaviour.** In an isolated copy (since deleted) I put back the HEAD PanelControls.swift and SettingsSidebar.swift and dropped only the pure-geometry test so the rest compiles. The render-based tests then fail with 10 assertions: delay fill, underline at 126.5/187.5 against 122/192, missing hairline, an end tick at 4 pt, and an unblended tick colour.

**What I confirmed against Figma**
- **End ticks:** gone everywhere; tickFractions for `stops` now covers only the inner stops. Essential, Sepia, Spatializer, Stereo Widener and Background Opacity show inner ticks only and the thumbs sit on their ticks.
- **Tick count and blend:** I confirmed in figma_file.json that all 75 `degrees` frames use SCREEN blending. The Feedback frame 612:1260 has 10 marks, 8 of them inner, so the parity judge's "Figma 6" was a miscount and needs no decision.
- **Tab underline:** pixel probe at y 97 px matches exactly — 244–383 for Video, 416–555 for Audio, 28–210 for Playback, 589–771 for Subtitles.
- **Playback hairline:** #222 across the full width at y 102 px against Figma's #212121, and only on the Playback tab, which matches Figma.
- **Delay fill:** ends at 184 pt; the thumb is 0.5 pt left of Figma's.

**Check results (my reruns)**
- PASS: S19 spatializer-open (0.003 %), stereoWidener-open (0.001 %), S18 card-closed.
- REVIEW: S19 compressor-open (0.022 %, flat 0), S18 essential-open (0.037 %), colors-open (0.100 %), S20 subtitles (0.034 %, flat 0), and everything else in S14–S24, with no regressions.
- FAIL: S17.Sidebar/playback stays at 9.155 % flat colour. That comes only from the D033/D014 row shift, which the parity judge accepted.

**The D054 deviations are legitimate.** The raw comparison with deviations ignored shows Figma's compressor thumbs really contradict their own labels (Ratio 4:1 drawn at 31 % where 16 % is correct), so the difference cannot be made to match. The new D054 bullet for the '+10 s' typo is a single line and is justified by 1905:7372.

**Ownership and rules**
- Only G-panels files changed, plus the minimal D054 bullet. The engine diff against upstream-base-2026-10-14 for src, lib, include and modules/gui/macosx is empty.
- No thresholds were loosened.
- The one new literal (`selectedNarrowTabUnderlineInset` 7.5) sits in the existing PanelMetric enum of Figma-sourced metrics, which follows the area's convention.

**Open items not done by the fixer, both minor**
- The Equalizer Preamp example was not added to D054 and has no figmaDeviation, so that entry still reports REVIEW with an unexplained area.
- The Light-scheme look of screen-blended ticks is unchecked; it is in the live checks.

Evidence is in ../build/evidence/final5/polish/G-panels-verify-r1/: a folder per entry with report, render, ref and side-by-side, plus appear.png, compact.png and subs-light.png.

liveChecks.steps: Open a video and open the settings sidebar. Click Video, then Audio, then Playback, then Subtitles.
liveChecks.expect: The selected Video or Audio underline is 70 pt wide, about 4.5 pt beyond the icon and title on each side. The unselected narrow tabs keep a 61 pt grey underline. The Playback and Subtitles underlines span their cell minus 8 pt. Nothing jumps or shifts sideways when switching tabs.

liveChecks.steps: On the Playback tab, scroll the content a little. Then switch to Video.
liveChecks.expect: Playback shows a 1 px #222 line across the full width directly under the tab strip, and it stays put while the content scrolls under it. The Video, Audio and Subtitles tabs have no such line.

liveChecks.steps: Video > Essential > Expand Settings, then drag Gamma and Film Grain from one end to the other. Audio > Spatializer: drag Size. Subtitles > Appearance: drag Background Opacity and Font Size.
liveChecks.expect: There are no marks inside the rounded track ends. The thumb snaps to each stop, centred on its tick, and stops 2 pt inside the track at both ends. Dragging moves the thumb under the pointer with no lag or offset at the ends.

liveChecks.steps: Switch the app to Light. Open Video > Essential (expanded) and Subtitles > Appearance.
liveChecks.expect: The inner ticks stay visible as subtle marks on both the empty track and the fill. They are not invisible and do not clash, now that screen blending makes them lighter than the light track.

liveChecks.steps: Subtitles tab: type -4 into Subtitle Track Delay, then drag the slider through 0 to +4. Repeat on the Audio tab's delay sliders.
liveChecks.expect: At −4 s the fill runs from the thumb to the far edge of the 0 s position. At +4 s it runs from the 0 s position to the thumb's right edge. At 0 the thumb is centred over '0 s'. The labels read −10 s / 0 s / +10 s on both tabs. The value field follows the drag.

liveChecks.steps: Playback tab: open Sleep Timer and choose a value. Open Audio Visualizer and choose a value. Then press Esc on an open list.
liveChecks.expect: The list opens below the field in the shared dropdown style, with the current value checked. Choosing a value closes the list and updates the field. Esc, or a click outside, closes it.
